title: Read independently authorized Command Tasks linked to a selected Incident Detail
goal: Complete the canonical Incident coordination read flow: display existing Command Task ownership/status/timestamp next to the selected Incident, using an independently authorized Incident->Task relation and the exact existing Command Owner.List/CanRead Task projection. No Task creation, assignment, mutation or duplicate authorization engine.
invariants: Selected Incident.read is re-authorized by unchanged Project; only a trusted optional IncidentTaskReferencesOwner yields scoped Incident->Task IDs.
Each linked Task must exist in a freshly listed Command owner collection and independently pass the SAME Owner.CanRead with Kind=Task, current principal, tenant and environment.
Link is not Task.read; denied, absent, cross-tenant and duplicate references never expose Task IDs or sensitive metadata. A source failure blocks any Incident Detail HTML before response.
No new Task owner, status machine, persistence, assignment rights, update action or automatic Incident mutation.
The narrow existing Task Row projection only has id, owner, status and updatedAt; canonical Task source version and rich Task Detail remain unknown rather than invented.
Owner.List second read is not transactional across Incident and Task; Task source time is surfaced, no consistency/production guarantee.
Legacy Command hosts without IncidentTaskReferencesOwner remain backward compatible and display an explicitly partial Task state.
security_properties: Fail closed on >12 relation records, duplicate/foreign/invalid identifiers, >5000 owner records, changed scope, owner errors, invalid owner/status text or missing/invalid timestamp.
No output of denied Task IDs or counts, no Task action URL, no direct second ACL engine.
Source errors are generic and HTML is buffered until all providers finish. Existing CSP and no-store headers unchanged.
inputs: CAP-CMD-106 owner and Task coordination, CAP-CMD-101 existing Command Owner.List/CanRead, optional IncidentTaskReferencesOwner from host only.
Frozen PR #214 local Incident Detail with next action, Alert, Govern Results and Case links, SHA 38d1131556023b427021422950b52aa2a67824b3.
outputs: Existing GET /command/incident-detail shows only independently read-authorized linked Task id, owner/status and source updatedAt, without new endpoint or mutation.
Local loopback with analyst sees synthetic linked Task; commander has Incident permission but no Task.read and sees no Task ID.
Direct Go unit tests and real Go HTTP fixture verify positive, negative, malformed, lost permission, legacy behavior, oversized owner and cancelled request.
acceptance_tests: Authorized Incident with scoped Task relation, Task in existing Command owner listing and individual Task CanRead=true => Task visibly listed in existing Incident Detail.
Incident reader lacking Task.read sees neither linked Task ID nor source metadata, including on later reaccess.
Broken tenant/env/incident/duplicate relation, malformed Task owner data, cancelled request, failed sources and bound overflows fail closed without partial HTML.
Legacy owner implementation without Task relation interface still shows Incident Detail and explicitly partial Task source.
Existing three GitHub workflows on exact SHA all pass, including workqueue Go race/vet, local real HTTP tests and mandatory engineering security checks.

migration.rationale: Optional read-only rendering of existing Command Tasks and relation references; no storage, schema migration or production configuration.

rollback.strategy: Revert local source demo Task and additive Incident Detail Task list; original Incident owner and route remain unchanged.
verification: Existing Work Queue and Incident Detail tests pass
No Task creation or state mutation
